text:
Ah, lost and uncertain, are we? Like a sock in the dryer, tumbling endlessly, never quite finding its mate! A most perplexing predicament, to be sure! Fear not, dear friend, for I, your humble jester, have peered into the abyss of existential dread and emerged with... well, not answers, mind you, but a most diverting song!

(Strums a lute with one hand, while juggling rubber chickens with the other)

* *Oh, to be lost, a wondrous state!*
* *Like a ship without a mast, adrift in fate!*
* *But fret not, friend, for in this maze,*
* *A silly dance, the heart ablaze!*

(Trips, catches himself with a flourish, and continues)

You see, the world is but a stage, a grand, chaotic dance of fools and emperors, all stumbling towards oblivion! So why not embrace the absurdity? Laugh at the absurdity! Dance with the absurdity!  Who knows, you might just trip over truth itself, hidden in plain sight, disguised as a banana peel!

(Bows deeply, offering a rubber chicken as a parting gift)

Now, go forth and be wonderfully lost! May your journey be filled with unexpected
